name: Ukraine

nso.name: State Statistics Service of Ukraine (Derzhstat); census portal ukrcensus.gov.ua

latest_census.notes: All-Ukrainian Population Census, 5 December 2001, State Statistics Committee -- the only census independent Ukraine has held (48,457,100 people). Search snippets list its topics as population, urban/rural, sex, age, ethnicity (nationality) and language, education, marital status; religion was not a census topic. The next census was planned for 2011, rescheduled repeatedly (2023 at the last plan), and under the census law cannot be held during martial law or for six months after it. Published subnationally: nationality and native language by region (oblast) on the official site; the U.S. Census Bureau's HDX workbook carries both by rayon.

tier_reason: Ethnicity (nationality) is a 2001 census count, machine-readable in the HDX/U.S. Census Bureau XLSX the project already fetches for language, by rayon and summable into the 27 oblasts = admin1 with the existing sum_into machinery; the official site publishes the same field by region in HTML as a check. Religion is C: never asked.
recommended_action: (1) In uscb.py's UKRAINE config, read the 'Nationality-Language' sheet as an ethnicity topic: collapse its 1,619 columns to per-nationality totals (sum across languages, or use total columns if present) before the existing sum_into=1 step; reconcile against the census's 48,121,632 and against the official per-region HTML pages. (2) Declare religion not_collected at every level, reason: the 2001 census did not ask religion and no census has been held since. (3) admin2 (494 old raions) stays closed on the name-join problem SOURCES.md records; revisit only with a code-based join.

summary: Ukraine's only census (2001) asked nationality and native language but not religion, and no census has been held since. The map already fills admin1 language from the U.S. Census Bureau's HDX workbook; the project's own reader notes that the same workbook carries a 'Nationality-Language' cross-tab by rayon, whose margins give nationality by rayon and, summed, by the 27 oblasts -- the fastest route to admin1 ethnicity, checkable against the official per-region HTML pages on 2001.ukrcensus.gov.ua. Religion should be declared not_collected. The 494 admin2 shapes (pre-2020 raions) remain closed on the name-join problem already recorded.
